layouts.marketing_hero: Asymmetrical split. Heavy text on left with neon accents, large overlapping EV scooter image on right. Use generous padding (py-24, py-32).
layouts.booking_form: Mobile-first, stacked layout. Inputs must use high contrast borders. Use Shadcn components heavily customized to look 'technical'.
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density grid mode. Sidebar for navigation. Top metrics row (3-4 columns). Main table for orders. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Flat solid surfaces.

surfaces.marketing_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10
surfaces.admin_cards: Flat solid background #121212 with 1px border #2A2A2A. No shadows.
surfaces.buttons: Sharp corners or max 4px radius. High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-[#00CC52] hover:text-black). Primary CTA gets 'Tracing Beam' or subtle drop-shadow glow.

components.form: Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Calendar (for date). Overwrite border to be #2A2A2A and focus-ring to be #00FF66.
components.table: Shadcn Table for admin dashboard. Ensure high contrast text for row data. Status badge (Pending = Yellow/Orange, In Progress = Blue/Volt, Completed = Muted Green/White).
components.toast: Use Sonner for booking confirmation and status update notifications. Customize background to #121212 and border to #2A2A2A.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, technical look.

animations.hover: Translate-y-[-2px] and subtle brightness increase on cards.
animations.page_load: Staggered fade-up for dashboard rows and marketing elements.

hero_scooter.description: Electric scooter at night, use for landing page hero or background overlay

workshop_mechanic.description: Mechanic holding tools, use for 'About Service' or booking context section

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary green text (#00FF66) against #0A0A0A passes APCA. Buttons must have explicit hover colors. Form fields require visible labels.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-booking-button', data-testid='status-dropdown').

instructions_to_main_agent: Run: npx shadcn-ui@latest add form input select calendar popover table badge card dropdown-menu
Update tailwind.config.js to set font families: 'Outfit' for sans (headings) and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body.
Use JS/JSX syntax for React files instead of TS/TSX.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the dropdown menus or header. Always use bg-black/60 with blur or solid #121212.
Implement two main routes: '/' (Landing + Booking Form) and '/admin' (Dashboard).
Dashboard must list orders with columns: Customer, Location, Scooter, Issue, Date, Status, Actions. Use Shadcn Table.
Avoid centered text layouts. Left-align most text for readability and modern brutalist tech feel.
Implement Sonner toast for 'Booking Successful' and 'Order Status Updated'.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more padding than usual. E.g., py-24 for sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.borders: No soft shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders (border-white/10) for separation.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.interactions: Never use 'transition: all'. Explicitly define transition properties (colors, transform).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid: Mandatory on all clickable elements and forms for testing.
